name: Miscarriages
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of miscarriages within the brokenness of a fallen world, yet it affirms God's sovereign care and intimate knowledge of life even in the womb. Passages like Psalms 139 highlight God's detailed involvement in forming each person before birth, while Exodus 23:26 reflects His promise of blessing and fruitfulness. In times of loss, the Lord draws near to the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds (Psalms 34:18; 147:3), reminding believers that He both gives and takes away according to His perfect will (Job 1:21).
